typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		LinkLevelName as string,
		StartDate as timestamp,
		OriginalCurrencyKey as string,
		SourceSystemDateCreated as timestamp,
		SourceSystemDateModified as timestamp,
		EffectiveDate as timestamp,
		ExpirationDate as timestamp,
		LineageId as long,
		LoadDate as timestamp,
		PolicyKey as string,
		SourceSystemCodeForHash as string,
		InsuredObjectKey as string,
		LayerKey as string,
		PerilKey as string,
		PolicyVariableLevelKey as string,
		LimitDeductibleSIRKey as string,
		LimitDeductibleSIRName as string,
		LimitDeductibleSIRDesc as string,
		LimitDeductibleSIRFlag as string,
		SharedInd as string,
		SplitInd as string,
		CSLInd as string,
		ALAEErodesInd as string,
		ALAEIncludedInd as string,
		StackedInd as string,
		DeductibleSIRErodesLimitInd as string,
		ReplacementValueInd as string,
		LimitDeductibleSIRCode as string,
		BatchId as integer,
		LastModifiedBatchId as integer,
		Coveragekey as string,
		LimitDeductibleSIRType as string,
		LimitDeductibleSIRDetailName as string,
		LimitDeductibleSIRDetailDesc as string,
		LimitDeductibleSIRValueType as string,
		LimitDeductibleSIRValue as string,
		LimitDeductibleSIRCountUnitType as string,
		PercentageResponsible as string,
		ActualCashValueInd as string,
		LimitDeductibleSIRInd as string,
		WithinLayerInd as string,
		BreachesLayerInd as string,
		TrailingInd as string,
		BusinessKeyHash as string,
		ContentHash as string,
		DataVarInd as string,
		DataVarIndDate as timestamp,
		GranLevelHash as string,
		LineKey as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT    [PolicyKey]= cast(upper(rtrim(ltrim(PolicyKey))) as nvarchar(50))       ,[LayerKey]= cast(upper(rtrim(ltrim([LayerKey]))) as nvarchar(50))       ,[InsuredObjectKey]= cast(upper(rtrim(ltrim([InsuredObjectKey]))) as nvarchar(100))       ,[Coveragekey]= cast(upper(rtrim(ltrim([Coveragekey]))) as nvarchar(100))       ,[PerilKey]= cast(upper(rtrim(ltrim([PerilKey]))) as nvarchar(50))       ,[PolicyVariableLevelKey]= cast(upper(rtrim(ltrim([PolicyVariableLevelKey]))) as nvarchar(200))          , [LimitDeductibleSIRKey]       ,[LimitDeductibleSIRName]       ,[LimitDeductibleSIRCode]       ,[LimitDeductibleSIRDesc]       ,[LimitDeductibleSIRFlag]       ,[LinkLevelName]                                           ,[StartDate]       ,[OriginalCurrencyKey]       ,[SharedInd]       ,[SplitInd]       ,[CSLInd]       ,[ALAEErodesInd]       ,[ALAEIncludedInd]       ,[StackedInd]       ,[DeductibleSIRErodesLimitInd]       ,[ReplacementValueInd]       ,[SourceSystemDateCreated]       ,[SourceSystemDateModified]       ,[EffectiveDate]       ,[ExpirationDate]       ,[LimitDeductibleSIRType]       ,[LimitDeductibleSIRDetailName]       ,[LimitDeductibleSIRDetailDesc]       ,[LimitDeductibleSIRValueType]       ,[LimitDeductibleSIRValue]       ,[LimitDeductibleSIRCountUnitType]       ,[PercentageResponsible]       ,[ActualCashValueInd]       ,[LimitDeductibleSIRInd]       ,[WithinLayerInd]       ,[BreachesLayerInd]       ,[TrailingInd]       ,[LoadDate]       ,[LineageId]       ,[BusinessKeyHash]       ,[ContentHash]       ,[DataVarInd]       ,[DataVarIndDate]       ,[GranLevelHash]     ,s.SourceSystemCodeForHash  ,[BatchId] ,[LastModifiedBatchId]  ,LineKey   FROM  Policy.[LimitDeductibleSIR] a       ,(select SourceSystemCode as SourceSystemCodeForHash, BatchId, [LastModifiedBatchId]=BatchId from control.SourceSystem) s',
	format: 'query') ~> OLESRCLDSIRStaging
source(output(
		SourceSystemId as long,
		SourceSystemCode as string,
		SourceSystemDesc as string,
		BusinessKeyHash as string,
		ContentHash as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from Control.SourceSystem',
	format: 'query') ~> LKPSourceSystemLKPTABLE
source(output(
		PolicyLevelsCompoundId as long,
		PolicyKey as string,
		LayerKey as string,
		InsuredObjectKey as string,
		CoverageKey as string,
		PerilKey as string,
		PolicyVariableLevelKey as string,
		SourceSystemId as long
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT   PolicyLevelsCompoundId,   PolicyKey= cast(upper(rtrim(ltrim(PolicyKey))) as nvarchar(50))       ,LayerKey= cast(upper(rtrim(ltrim(LayerKey))) as nvarchar(50))       ,InsuredObjectKey= cast(upper(rtrim(ltrim(InsuredObjectKey))) as nvarchar(100))       ,CoverageKey= cast(upper(rtrim(ltrim(Coveragekey))) as nvarchar(100))       ,PerilKey= cast(upper(rtrim(ltrim(PerilKey))) as nvarchar(50))       ,PolicyVariableLevelKey= cast(upper(rtrim(ltrim(PolicyVariableLevelKey))) as nvarchar(200))       ,SourceSystemId   FROM Policy.PolicyLevelsCompound y with (nolock);',
	format: 'query') ~> LKPPLCompoundId1LKPTABLE
OLESRCLDSIRStaging derive(LinkLevelName = LinkLevelName) ~> PlaceHolderYHCSourceSystemHash
PlaceHolderYHCSourceSystemHash, LKPSourceSystemLKPTABLE lookup(OLESRCLDSIRStaging@BusinessKeyHash == LKPSourceSystemLKPTABLE@BusinessKeyHash,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'auto')~> LKPSourceSystem
LKPSourceSystem select(mapColumn(
		ContentHash = OLESRCLDSIRStaging@ContentHash,
		BusinessKeyHash = {YHCSourceSystemHash@BusinessKeyHash},
		BusinessKeyHashInput,
		LoadDate,
		LimitDeductibleSIRFlag,
		SplitInd,
		LimitDeductibleSIRCode,
		LinkLevelName,
		LastModifiedBatchId,
		PolicyVariableLevelKey,
		StartDate,
		SourceSystemCodeForHash,
		ReplacementValueInd,
		PolicyKey,
		ALAEErodesInd,
		DeductibleSIRErodesLimitInd,
		StackedInd,
		LineageId,
		InsuredObjectKey,
		LimitDeductibleSIRDesc,
		BatchId,
		SourceSystemDateModified,
		SourceSystemDateCreated,
		PerilKey,
		LimitDeductibleSIRName,
		CSLInd,
		Coveragekey,
		LimitDeductibleSIRKey,
		ExpirationDate,
		SharedInd,
		OriginalCurrencyKey,
		LayerKey,
		EffectiveDate,
		ALAEIncludedInd,
		SourceSystemId,
		SourceSystemCode,
		SourceSystemDesc
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LKPSourceSystem01
LKPSourceSystem01 filter(isMatch()) ~> LKPSourceSystem0
LKPSourceSystem0 derive(SourceSystemId = SourceSystemId) ~> PlaceHolderYHCPolicyLevelsCompoundKey
PlaceHolderYHCPolicyLevelsCompoundKey, LKPPLCompoundId1LKPTABLE lookup(LKPSourceSystem01@PolicyKey == LKPPLCompoundId1LKPTABLE@PolicyKey
	&& LKPSourceSystem01@InsuredObjectKey == LKPPLCompoundId1LKPTABLE@InsuredObjectKey
	&& LKPSourceSystem01@LayerKey == LKPPLCompoundId1LKPTABLE@LayerKey
	&& LKPSourceSystem01@PerilKey == LKPPLCompoundId1LKPTABLE@PerilKey
	&& LKPSourceSystem01@PolicyVariableLevelKey == LKPPLCompoundId1LKPTABLE@PolicyVariableLevelKey
	&& LKPSourceSystem01@Coveragekey == LKPPLCompoundId1LKPTABLE@CoverageKey
	&& PlaceHolderYHCPolicyLevelsCompoundKey@SourceSystemId == LKPPLCompoundId1LKPTABLE@SourceSystemId,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'auto')~> LKPPLCompoundId1
LKPPLCompoundId1 select(mapColumn(
		ContentHash,
		BusinessKeyHash,
		BusinessKeyHashInput,
		LoadDate,
		LimitDeductibleSIRFlag,
		SplitInd,
		LimitDeductibleSIRCode,
		LinkLevelName,
		LastModifiedBatchId,
		PolicyVariableLevelKey = {YHCPolicyLevelsCompoundKey@PolicyVariableLevelKey},
		SourceSystemId = {YHCPolicyLevelsCompoundKey@SourceSystemId},
		StartDate,
		SourceSystemCodeForHash,
		ReplacementValueInd,
		PolicyKey = {YHCPolicyLevelsCompoundKey@PolicyKey},
		ALAEErodesInd,
		DeductibleSIRErodesLimitInd,
		StackedInd,
		LineageId,
		InsuredObjectKey = {YHCPolicyLevelsCompoundKey@InsuredObjectKey},
		LimitDeductibleSIRDesc,
		BatchId,
		SourceSystemDateModified,
		SourceSystemDateCreated,
		PerilKey = {YHCPolicyLevelsCompoundKey@PerilKey},
		LimitDeductibleSIRName,
		CSLInd,
		Coveragekey = {YHCPolicyLevelsCompoundKey@Coveragekey},
		LimitDeductibleSIRKey,
		ExpirationDate,
		SharedInd,
		OriginalCurrencyKey,
		LayerKey = {YHCPolicyLevelsCompoundKey@LayerKey},
		EffectiveDate,
		ALAEIncludedInd,
		PolicyLevelsCompoundId,
		CoverageKey = {YHCPolicyLevelsCompoundKey@Coveragekey}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LKPPLCompoundId10
LKPPLCompoundId10 split(isMatch(),
	disjoint: true) ~> LKPPLCompoundId1IsMatch@(Match, NotMatch)
LKPPLCompoundId1IsMatch@Match derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DERLoadDate
LKPPLCompoundId1IsMatch@NotMatch derive({} = ERROR_FUNCTION('')) ~> PlaceHolderYHCRiskFactorsBusinessHash
DERLoadDate derive(LoadDate = LoadDate) ~> PlaceHolderYHCLimitDedSIRKeyHash
PlaceHolderYHCRiskFactorsBusinessHash derive(ContentHash = ContentHash) ~> PlaceHolderYHCInsuredObjectBK
PlaceHolderYHCInsuredObjectBK sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'parquet',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		LimitDeductibleSIRFlag,
		SplitInd,
		LimitDeductibleSIRCode,
		LinkLevelName,
		LastModifiedBatchId,
		StartDate,
		SourceSystemCodeForHash,
		ReplacementValueInd,
		ALAEErodesInd,
		DeductibleSIRErodesLimitInd,
		StackedInd,
		LineageId,
		LimitDeductibleSIRDesc,
		BatchId,
		SourceSystemDateModified,
		SourceSystemDateCreated,
		LimitDeductibleSIRName,
		CSLInd,
		LimitDeductibleSIRKey,
		ExpirationDate,
		SharedInd,
		OriginalCurrencyKey,
		EffectiveDate,
		ALAEIncludedInd,
		PolicyLevelsCompoundId,
		ContentHash
	)) ~> DSTLoadErrorLimitDedSIRwithmissingcompound
PlaceHolderYHCLimitDedSIRKeyHash sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'parquet',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		LimitDeductibleSIRFlag,
		SplitInd,
		LimitDeductibleSIRCode,
		LinkLevelName,
		LastModifiedBatchId,
		StartDate,
		SourceSystemCodeForHash,
		ReplacementValueInd,
		ALAEErodesInd,
		DeductibleSIRErodesLimitInd,
		StackedInd,
		LineageId,
		LimitDeductibleSIRDesc,
		BatchId,
		SourceSystemDateModified,
		SourceSystemDateCreated,
		LimitDeductibleSIRName,
		CSLInd,
		LimitDeductibleSIRKey,
		ExpirationDate,
		SharedInd,
		OriginalCurrencyKey,
		EffectiveDate,
		ALAEIncludedInd,
		PolicyLevelsCompoundId
	)) ~> OLEDSTDWTempLimitDedandSIRSforUpdatesonly
